messages.text: Turn these Hermes integration acceptance requirements into a concise five-bullet internal checklist: use the existing local runtime and original conversation; recover an original request without automatic resend; reopen saved history; clear the displayed conversation on logout and reconnect safely; keep public Apple signing, notarization and updater distribution on hold until separately qualified. Mark these as requirements, not proven results. Do not use tools.

- **Session Context Preservation**: Maintain original local runtime and conversation state; avoid automatic request resends or session resets.  
- **Request Recovery**: Support reopening and verifying saved history without relying on resent requests or external triggers.  
- **Logout Security**: Clear all displayed conversation data upon logout; ensure safe reconnection to the same session without残留.  
- **Apple Ecosystem Hold**: Suspend public Apple signing, notarization, and updater distribution until separately approved by authorized channels.  
- **Runtime Isolation**: Use the original conversation context and local runtime strictly; prohibit dynamic tool invocation for validation.
